import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static int baseK;
    static int MAXK;
    static int MAXD;
    static State[] power;
    static int[] digits;

    static class State {
        int[][] mat;
        int[] inside;
        boolean[] exist;

        State() {
            mat = new int[MAXK][MAXK];
            inside = new int[MAXK];
            exist = new boolean[MAXK];
        }

        State(State other, int rot) {
            this();
            for (int i = 0; i < baseK; i++) {
                exist[(i + rot) % baseK] = other.exist[i];
                inside[(i + rot) % baseK] = other.inside[i];
                for (int j = 0; j < baseK; j++) {
                    mat[(i + rot) % baseK][(j + rot) % baseK] = other.mat[i][j];
                }
            }
        }

        State(State a, State b) {
            this();
            for (int i = 0; i < baseK; i++) {
                exist[i] = a.exist[i] || b.exist[i];
                inside[i] = a.inside[i];
                if (!a.exist[i]) inside[i] = (inside[i] + b.inside[i]) % MOD;
                for (int j = 0; j < baseK; j++) {
                    inside[i] = (int)((inside[i] + (long)a.mat[i][j] * b.inside[j]) % MOD);
                    mat[i][j] = 0;
                    if (!b.exist[j]) mat[i][j] = a.mat[i][j];
                    if (!a.exist[i]) mat[i][j] = (int)((mat[i][j] + b.mat[i][j]) % MOD);
                    for (int m = 0; m < baseK; m++) {
                        mat[i][j] = (int)((mat[i][j] + (long)a.mat[i][m] * b.mat[m][j]) % MOD);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        baseK = sc.nextInt();

        // Set MAXK and MAXD based on problem constraints
        // For demonstration, assuming maximums:
        MAXK = 50; // Adjust as needed
        MAXD = 50; // Adjust as needed

        power = new State[MAXD];
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXD; i++) {
            power[i] = new State();
        }
        digits = new int[MAXD];

        int length = 0;
        long x = n;
        while (x > 0) {
            digits[length++] = (int)(x % baseK);
            x /= baseK;
        }

        // Initialize power[0]
        power[0].exist[0] = true;
        power[0].inside[0] = 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < baseK; j++) {
            power[0].mat[0][j] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < length; i++) {
            power[i] = power[i - 1];
            for (int v = 1; v < baseK; v++) {
                power[i] = new State(power[i], new State(power[i - 1], v));
            }
        }

        State result = new State();
        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int v = 0; v < digits[i]; v++) {
                result = new State(result, new State(power[i], (sum + v) % baseK));
            }
            sum += digits[i];
        }

        long total = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < baseK; i++) {
            total = (total + result.inside[i]) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(total);
        sc.close();
    }
}
